size_band: Mid-size (about 350 workers in Córdoba plus 50 in Pacheco before closure)
the_problem: Furniture maker Color Living saw sales fall about 50% when Milei took office, then fell further from mid-2025; it ran at a loss for three months and the Pacheco plant (Buenos Aires) lost 60% of production and sales according to the wood workers' union.
the_decision: Founder and president Omar Polo Gardinelli closed the General Pacheco plant to concentrate production in Córdoba, telling the workforce in person with the union present. His stated reason: "o paro una planta y cierro la más chica o me fundo y cierro todo"; he added "No hay crédito, lo poco que hay es carísimo" and that banks charge 43%-55% to discount cheques while inflation is 30%.
the_outcome: 40 workers laid off at Pacheco (the plant of about 50 becomes a warehouse), with a promise to pay severance "hasta el último peso"; the Córdoba plant keeps about 350 workers and 100,000 units a year, but the company had worked three months at a loss.
